name: financas-da-familia
description: Dashboard financeiro familiar: despesas, entradas, parcelas, faturas e lembretes por email.

scripts.dev: npm run tokens && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @ff/server" "npm run dev:worker -w @ff/server" "npm run dev -w @ff/web"
scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run build -w @ff/web && npm run build -w @ff/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ff/shared && npm run test -w @ff/server
